title: Suffering
author: Rohit Dash
text:
As if I am destined to suffer
Your opinion on me may differ
Most of the night
I can not sleep
The wound in my
Heart is so deep.

I know I will never
Be on peace
Even if I wish
Nor any God is of
Any help for me
Thus I too have
Lost my trust
There is nothing for me
With Which I can adjust
May it be winter or spring
I am always suffering.

Not that i have not
Tried to come out
Of my situation
Despite all my efforts
I am unable to reach
My destination.

∎
Bargarh
stanzas: As if I am destined to suffer
Your opinion on me may differ
May it be winter or spring
